lines.speaker: Doflamingo
lines.text: Huff... dammit... all my threads... completely shattered?!

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: It's over, Doflamingo. Your marionette show has played its final act.

lines.speaker: Doflamingo
lines.text: Fuffuffu... unbelievable. To think a mere stray could shatter my cage.

lines.speaker: Doflamingo
lines.text: Don't get cocky. The tides of this era will soon swallow you whole!

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: Let the tides come. I will pave my own way forward.

lines.speaker: Doflamingo
lines.text: Fuffuffuffu! Then go forth and drown in the storm you just unleashed!
